'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****''[[The New York Times]]'' reports that the [[United States]] has sent [[Iran]] a 15-point plan to end the [[war]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/24/trump-iran-war-negotiations.html (CNBC)]

[https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/south-asia/article/3347744/pakistan-seeks-mediate-talks-us-iran-islamabad (AFP via ''SCMP'')] [https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/659976/world/pakistan-offers-to-host-us-iran-talks-to-end-war (''Saudi Gazette'')]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Israel]]
****Shrapnel from an [[Iran]]ian [[Ballistic missile program of Iran|ballistic missile]] wounds three people, including a two-month-old baby, in a [[Bedouin]] community in the [[Negev]], [[Israel]]. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-891047 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[Iraq in the 2026 Iran war]]
****Fifteen fighters from [[Iraq]]'s [[Popular Mobilization Forces]] (PMF), including a commander, are killed in an [[United States Armed Forces|American]] [[airstrike]] on a PMF base in the [[Al Anbar Governorate]]. [https://www.bssnews.net/international/371171 (AFP via BSS)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****[[Hezbollah]] rocket fire kills a woman and injures two others in [[Northern District (Israel)|northern Israel]]. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-891047 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
****[[Israeli Defense Ministry|Israeli defense minister]] [[Israel Katz]] states that [[Israeli Defense Forces|the military]] will control a "security zone" up to the [[Litani River]] in [[southern Lebanon]] until "the threat of [[Hezbollah]]" is removed, while also suggesting that Israel will remain in control of the area after the conflict is resolved. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/katz-says-israel-will-hold-security-zone-in-south-lebanon-until-hezbollah-threat-removed/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/24/world/middleeast/israel-southern-lebanon-defense-minister.html (''The New York Times'')]
****The [[Lebanese government]] reports that the death toll from Israeli attacks on [[Lebanon|the country]] since March 2 has risen to 1,039. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/lebanon-s-death-toll-from-israeli-attacks-since-early-march-rises-to-1-039/3876191 (AA)] 
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Zaporizhzhia strikes (2022–present)|Zaporizhzhia strikes]], [[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] missile and drone strikes across [[Ukraine]] kill at least three people, including two in [[Poltava]] and one in [[Zaporizhzhia]], and injures several others. The attacks also damage residential buildings and infrastructure in the areas. [https://www.bssnews.net/international/371114 (AFP via BSS)]
**[[Lviv strikes (2022–present)|Lviv strikes]]
***A Russian [[Shahed drones|Shahed drone]] strikes and severely damages the [[Bernardine Church, Lviv|Bernardine Church]], a [[World Heritage Site|UNESCO World Heritage Site]], in [[Lviv]], [[western Ukraine]]. [https://globalnation.inquirer.net/315406/zelensky-slams-russias-massive-drone-attack (AFP via ''Philippine Daily Inqurier'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***The death toll from the March 20 drone strike on the Al Deain Teaching Hospital in [[East Darfur]], [[Sudan]], rises to 70. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/death-toll-sudan-hospital-strike-rises-70-who-says-2026-03-24/ (Reuters)]
**[[2026 Blue Nile campaign]]

[https://www.arabnews.com/node/2637541/middle-east (AFP via ''Arab News'')]

**At least 84 people are killed in [[flash flood]]s across [[Kenya]], including in [[Kisumu County|Kisumu]], [[Uasin Gishu County|Uasin Gishu]], and [[Tana River County|Tana River counties]]. [https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/2026-03-24-flash-floods-kill-84-across-kenya (''The Star'')]

*[[Iran–Lebanon relations]]
**[[2026 Lebanon war]]
***The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Emigrants (Lebanon)|Lebanese foreign ministry]] declares the Iranian [[ambassador]] a ''[[persona non grata]]'' and gives him until March 29 to leave [[Lebanon|the country]], due to [[Hezbollah–Iran relations|Iran's financial and military support]] of [[Shia Islam|Shia]] paramilitary group [[Hezbollah]]. **The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian foreign ministry]] states that vessels it classifies as [[non-belligerent|non-hostile]] may pass through the [[Strait of Hormuz]] if they comply with its safety and security requirements, while excluding vessels linked to countries it accuses of involvement in the Iran war. [https://globalnation.inquirer.net/315412/iran-says-non-hostile-vessels-can-transit-strait-of-hormuz (AFP via ''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
